newGame.title: New game
newGame.description: Assign the models, set the pace, and choose who makes each Storyteller decision.
newGame.loading: Loading model presets and game configuration…
newGame.loadError: Could not load this configuration. Check the connection and try again.
newGame.templateNotice: Configuration copied from the previous game. A new random seed will be generated when you start.
newGame.noPresetsDescription: Create a provider and a model preset, then return here to assign your seats.
newGame.seatsDescription: The same preset can play more than one seat. Changing the seat count keeps your selections.
newGame.repickPreset: “{name}” has been deleted. Choose another preset.
newGame.languageDescription: Used for model prompts, AI speech, and game messages. The interface language is independent.
newGame.maxSpeechesDescription: Maximum speeches per seat in each conversation. At least 1.
newGame.whisperRoomsDescription: Maximum rooms each seat can join per whisper phase. Set to 0 to skip whispers.
newGame.discretionsDescription: All 14 decisions default to manual. Results are chosen during the game, not in this form.
newGame.storytellerDescription: Required because at least one decision uses the Storyteller model. It may use the same preset as a seat.

D1.label: D1 · Characters in play
D1.description: Choose a legal set of characters for this game.

seating.label: Seat assignment
seating.description: Assign the selected characters to seats.

D2.label: D2 · The Drunk’s believed character
D2.description: Choose the out-of-play Townsfolk character the Drunk believes they are.

D3.label: D3 · Fortune Teller’s red herring
D3.description: Choose the good player who registers as a Demon to the Fortune Teller.

D4.label: D4 · Washerwoman information
D4.description: Choose the Townsfolk character and pair of players shown to the Washerwoman.

D5.label: D5 · Librarian information
D5.description: Choose the Outsider character and pair of players shown to the Librarian, or report no Outsiders.

D6.label: D6 · Investigator information
D6.description: Choose the Minion character and pair of players shown to the Investigator.

D7.label: D7 · Demon bluffs
D7.description: Choose three out-of-play good characters to tell the Demon.

D8.label: D8 · Drunk or poisoned information
D8.description: Choose the information given when an information ability is malfunctioning.

D10.label: D10 · Spy registration
D10.description: Set the Spy’s registered alignment and character for the entire game.

D11.label: D11 · Recluse registration
D11.description: Set the Recluse’s registered alignment and character for the entire game.

D12.label: D12 · Mayor death substitution
D12.description: Decide whether another player dies when the Demon attacks the Mayor.

D13.label: D13 · Mayor’s substitute
D13.description: Choose the player who dies instead of the Mayor.

D14.label: D14 · Imp succession
D14.description: Choose the Minion who becomes the Imp after a successful self-kill, when no Scarlet Woman takes over.

newGame.missingEnvDescription: The game was not created. Set these environment variables on the server, then try again:
newGame.createError: Could not start the game. Check the connection and that your selected presets still exist, then try again.
newGame.incomplete: Choose a preset for every required model and enter valid pacing limits to start.
newGame.startDescription: The game starts immediately. Manual setup decisions appear in the spectator view.
